notes.title: Valentine's Day Update & 2 Year Anniversary Sale!
notes.content:
Can you believe it's been two years since [i]Max Gentlemen Sexy Business![/i] launched? 
(Well, technically it launched on the 25th but I'm going to cheat a little, if you'll forgive me.)

To celebrate this, the last [i]planned[/i] update, [i]Max Gentlemen Sexy Business![/i] is [b]69% off[/b]! That's the [u]largest[/u] discount we're likely to ever have!

We've added two new costume sets. A [b]Valentine's[/b] set and a [b]buff[/b] set to match the beard set we added in November. To unlock the buff costumes, just raise any executive's fisticuffs over 100. ːarmpumpː

Oh, and in case you needed an excuse to spend more time with your favorite executives, we've added 25 new friendships for Angel and Cashious with the rest of the cast! They become available near the end of the 3rd arc. (And should be available right away if you've reached that point.)

So maybe you noticed that I called this the [i]last planned update[/i]. What does that mean? Well, officially, [i]Sexy Business[/i] is no longer my first priority. It's time I moved on to a new project. It's been an amazing four years since I started [i]Sexy Business[/i] and I'm so happy to have been able to add the expansion and all these free updates. The community is really amazing and I'm sad to leave this project behind. Is this the end for Max Gentlemen? Probably not. I still have a few ideas for [i]Sexy Business[/i], but I have no idea when and if I will get to them. So for now, I hope what we made is good enough.

If you'd like to follow me, the developer, the best place to do that is twitter. [url=https://twitter.com/HatsProductions]@hatsproductions[/url]

If you'd like to squeeze as much blood out of the stone that is [i]Max Gentlemen Sexy Business![/i] I recommend dropping into the Discord to discuss the finer points of your favorite characters, outfits and dates. [url=https://discord.gg/Baj5dp2]https://discord.gg/Baj5dp2[/url]

Cheers!

notes.title: Optimization Focused Build v2.13
notes.content:
Hey everyone. For this build I tried to find ways to decrease load times and increase frame rates for lower end machines. I'm not sure how much of an impact these changes make but I hope this can improve the experience for at least a few players. Cheers!

[b]Optimization Focused Build 2.13 [/b]
[i]Tweaks:[/i]
[list]
[*] Optimized texture loading: requires less RAM to play
[*] Added "Simplified Resource Icons" to advanced options (slightly less CPU usage than default icons)
[*] Removed a shader thingy I wasn't using but was probably slowing down Gentsona rendering
[*] Biz events now use text speed settings
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Monster Prom crossover Event
notes.content:
[b]Boo![/b] Did I scare you?

If you are a fan of [i]Max Gentlemen[/i] then you are no doubt a fan of [i]Monster Prom[/i]. If not, you should really go check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/743450/Monster_Prom/]Monster Prom[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140270/Monster_Prom_2_Monster_Camp/?curator_clanid=33978800]sequel[/url] right now!

Victorian era London's sexiest executives are dressing up for the Halloween Season as their favorite Monster Prom characters! Can you guess who is dressed as who?

That right, just for the fun of it, we've added [b]16 new free costumes[/b] featuring your favorite Monster Prom characters. Simply boot up [i]Max Gentlemen Sexy Business![/i] and you can select a few to start. The rest can be unlocked via the Smut Peddler or bonus hearts.

v2.12 Patch Notes at the bottom. I hope you have a very spoopy Halloween.
Cheers!

notes.title: Free Update Delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone. It's now December and the "Fall" release window that I was aiming for for the Free [i]The British are COMING![/i] update is almost past us.

As you can imagine, the pandemic has impacted everyone on the team and our schedule was nothing more than wishful thinking during this bollocks of a year. Rest assured, this update is all I've been working on. We've even brought on 5 new team members since launch! On the plus side, the extra time means we've been able to add[i] even more [/i]content than we originally planned. So where does the update stand? Well, I'm currently aiming for "Winter(?)" now.

I apologize for the delay and it's heartbreaking to have to wait so long to share our work with you. I must ask you to wait a bit longer but I can promise it will be worth it (free!?) We could easily charge $10 for the amount of content we're adding -or- have rushed it out the door to meet the initial deadline but... well, nah I'd rather do a good job and reward our fan-base with the [b]luscious [/b]update you all deserve.

Speaking of, Here is a peek at [i]just some[/i] of features to expect in the update:
[list]
[*] New asset upgrades system
[*] 40+ new illustrations
[*] 50+ new outfits
[*] 70+ new genstona parts
[*] New business events
[*] A butt-load of unlockable "Friendships": vignettes between characters
[*] 4 new lunch date activities
[*] A dozen more [i]explicit [/i]Smutty Magazine unlocks (for the adult version) ːstachewinkː
[/list]

As always you are welcome to hop on our Discord for more frequent updates and discussion [url=https://discord.gg/BnhRpte]https://discord.gg/BnhRpte[/url]

Cheers!
